widgets_values:
Exercise: reuse a saved classifier - train once, predict forever

Run exercise_shape_classifier_hog.json FIRST: it trains the HOG+SVM shape classifier and saves it to ComfyUI/models/cvml/shape_classifier_hog.yml.gz (gzip-compressed OpenCV YAML). This workflow contains NO trainer: 'CV Predict Classifier' picks the saved file from the models/cvml dropdown, loads it and classifies a FRESH query set - the same three shapes, but rotations / noise / brightness the training run never produced. Loading and predicting happen inside one node call, so the model still never crosses a graph edge.

The features must be computed EXACTLY like at training time: the 'CV HOG Features' nodes here use the same default settings (81-dim), and 'CV Stack Feature Classes' provides the ground-truth labels for scoring. The accuracy is computed IN-GRAPH from generic nodes: cv2.compare (predictions vs truth, CMP_EQ -> 0/255) -> 'CV Reshape Array' to a column -> float32 -> divide by 255 -> 'CV Array Statistic' (mean) = the fraction classified correctly (chance 0.33). (To reuse the model OUTSIDE ComfyUI: gunzip the file, then cv2.ml.SVM_load reads the YAML.)

FAILURE PATH (bottom): feeding 2-D points into the 81-D model is a feature-length mismatch - 'CV Predict Classifier' answers success=false with empty predictions instead of raising.
